rationale.consistency: Follows sibling layout, license header and flag descriptions, but bypasses cmd.OptionsFromFlags (ctags setup lost) and inverts gitindex naming default so library callers outside the repo see changed behaviour; only zoekt-git-index is patched.
rationale.edge_cases: Handles duplicate names, root-as-repo, .git suffix, compound shards, missing index dir; misses symlinked roots (silently nothing found), aborts whole discovery on any unreadable dir, treats any dir with objects/ as bare repo, root named list/remove collides with subcommands.
rationale.scope: Changes are confined to the new command plus the minimal gitindex refactor; extra sync/help subcommands and path-based remove matching are small additions.
rationale.readability: Clear split into discover/index/main with good comments; describeRepo's manual done() bookkeeping on error paths is a bit clunky.
rationale.robustness: flock guards -f runs and dry run touches nothing; but IndexState swallows the index-state error, syscall.Flock is Unix-only, and remove reads inventory before taking the lock.
rationale.maintainability: ~/.zoekt index default duplicated in three places and could diverge; NameFromGitConfig semantics well documented, but the default-off opt-out flag is a trap for future callers.
